I'll look through the notes folder first so the plan matches how the files are named and organized.The minutes already share one date style in their headings. Nothing else in the repo points at the old filenames, so a rename plus a folder index is enough.Rename every file in `notes/` to `YYYY-MM-DD.md`, using the meeting date in each heading, and add `notes/README.md` as a chronological index. The minute text stays as it is. `members.csv` and the root `README.md` stay as they are: the root file only says that `notes/` holds the minutes, and nothing else links to these filenames.

## Rename

| Current file | New file | Meeting date |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `aug11.md` | `2026-08-11.md` | 11 August 2026 |
| `minutes 25 aug.md` | `2026-08-26.md` | 26 August 2026 (scheduled for the 25th, held the next day because of the storm) |
| `Meeting sept 8.md` | `2026-09-08.md` | 8 September 2026 |
| `notes_2026-09-22.md` | `2026-09-22.md` | 22 September 2026 |
| `oct6 meeting notes.md` | `2026-10-06.md` | 6 October 2026 |
| `2026.10.20 minutes.md` | `2026-10-20.md` | 20 October 2026 |
| `Nov 3 (final).md` | `2026-11-03.md` | 3 November 2026 (last meeting of the year; "(final)" comes off the name) |

Use `git mv` so history follows the files.

## Index

Add `notes/README.md`:

- Title: meeting minutes for the Alder Lane committee, 2026.
- A table, oldest first, with the date, a link to the file, and who was present (from each file's "Present" line).
- One note on the 26 August file: held on the 26th after the 25 August meeting was moved because of the storm.
- One note on 3 November: no further meetings this year.

## Check

List `notes/` and confirm seven dated files plus `README.md`, in date order, with no old names left. Open the index links against the real filenames.
thought:
I'll standardize the notes folder filenames and add an index.Reading the notes and README to understand the current content and naming conventions.Planning to standardize file names and add an index to the notes folder.

Current filenames mix formats. ISO dates like `notes_2026-09-22.md` are already used. I will standardize everything to that format.

The August 26 file will be renamed to 2026-08-26.md. The meeting was actually held on the 26th, not the 25th.

The index will be a README in the notes folder listing meetings chronologically. Scope is limited to renaming files and adding this index; existing minutes will not be rewritten.

The "(final)" suffix on the November file will be dropped from the filename. The index will note that this was the last meeting of the year. No clarifying questions are needed.

The root README will remain unchanged. It already accurately describes the notes folder without needing a link to the new index.

The index will be a simple table of dates with links to each file. The August 26 entry will note the storm postponement. The November entry will note it was the last meeting of the year. A notes column may be omitted to avoid editorializing.No other references to the filenames were found.I will reply with the full plan and stop.
